name: 3YoV
source: In a universe where virgins whom on their 30th birthday are granted wizard like powers by a magic familiar that visits them in the night. The story will follow our protagonist at this moment in his life where it is forever changed. As he learns to wield and control his new powers and the lewd antics that come with it along the way. Soon after receiving these new powers our MC will be invited to join the Virgin League Defense Force where he will meet fellow wizards as they try to shield Earth's citizens from threats that are within Earth itself and those beyond the stars. He will come across a variety of characters; whether it be from home, alien races or those from different universes altogether, many of whom will have romantic or lewd options in one shape or form.
translation: 在一个宇宙中，处女们在30岁生日时被夜间造访的魔法使魔赋予了巫师般的力量。这个故事将跟随我们的主角，在他生命中的这一刻发生永远的改变。当他学会运用和控制他的新力量以及随之而来的猥亵滑稽动作时。在获得这些新力量后不久，我们的MC将被邀请加入维珍联盟防御部队，在那里他将与其他巫师会面，因为他们试图保护地球公民免受地球内部和恒星之外的威胁。他会遇到各种各样的人物；无论是来自家乡、外星种族还是来自不同宇宙的人，他们中的许多人都会以一种形式或形式拥有浪漫或淫荡的选择。
